description: RC4 / FR5 — raise memory limits +50% off the LIVE 8Gi/8192 base per the user's recorded decision (a). The embeddings container 8Gi->12Gi already ships in FEAT-001's StatefulSet reconcile; this feature covers the REMAINING two targets: the reranker Deployment 8Gi->12Gi and the OmniRoute app OMNIROUTE_MEMORY_MB 8192->12288, plus reconciling the sizing comments. The reranker bump MUST be a value-only live patch that preserves its working HTTP readiness probe — applying the committed reranker manifest would swap in a /v3/rerank script probe that 404s live and drop it from rotation.
steps: Confirm the FEAT-001 embeddings bump took: embeddings limits.memory reads 12Gi. If for any reason it did not ship there, apply it here as part of the reconcile.

Apply a VALUE-ONLY live patch to the reranker, leaving its HTTP /v2/health/ready probe intact: kubectl -n omniroute-memory patch deploy ovms-reranker --type=json -p '[{"op":"replace","path":"/spec/template/spec/containers/0/resources/limits/memory","value":"12Gi"}]'. Do NOT apply the committed ovms-reranker-deployment.yaml (its exec /v3/rerank probe 404s live).
Raise the OmniRoute app memory setting: kubectl -n omniroute set env deploy/omniroute OMNIROUTE_MEMORY_MB=12288 (live patch, no sudo).

Update the declarative record: edit ~/sources/kube/omniroute-memory/ovms-reranker-deployment.yaml to memory: 12Gi and replace the ceiling-formula comment with the +50%/12Gi directive rationale; update the stale 'Pod memory limit: now 10Gi ...' line in ~/sources/kube/omniroute-memory/LIVE-VERIFICATION.md to the 12Gi/+50% rationale. Create a fresh .bak of ~/sources/kube/omniroute/omniroute.yaml and reconcile OMNIROUTE_MEMORY_MB=12288 in the file (BLOCKER: root-owned + no passwordless sudo — if the file cannot be written, the live kubectl change is authoritative; report the file reconcile for the user).
Confirm node headroom and no scheduling pressure after the patches (one embeddings + one reranker pod per node => 24Gi of limits/node, far under ~94GiB allocatable).
acceptance_criteria: OVMS container memory limits are 12Gi on BOTH the embeddings StatefulSet and the reranker Deployment, and OMNIROUTE_MEMORY_MB = 12288 (design AC6).
The reranker bump was a value-only live patch and the reranker stayed 1/1 throughout (its HTTP probe unchanged) (design AC6, AC8, F8).
No new Exit 137 / OOMKill and no Pending pods after the patches.
The sizing comments in ovms-reranker-deployment.yaml and LIVE-VERIFICATION.md state the +50%/12Gi rationale, not the stale 10Gi ceiling formula (design AC7, F3).

ssh ... 'kubectl -n omniroute get deploy omniroute -o jsonpath="{..env[?(@.name==\"OMNIROUTE_MEMORY_MB\")].value}"' — expect 12288.
ssh ... 'kubectl -n omniroute-memory get pods -l app=ovms-reranker' — reranker stays 1/1; and 'kubectl -n omniroute-memory get pods' shows no Pending/OOMKilled.
ssh ... 'kubectl describe node <gremlin-node>' — allocatable headroom confirmed.
